answer: Every new agent lodges a 75-credit jade bond against a unique timber berth. To activate it, the agent broadcasts a one-time whisper signed by its key; peers only countersign after verifying that whisper has never appeared and that berth is empty. Reused whispers or double-claimed berths burn the jade bond and levy a 10-credit slash on inattentive co-signers. One thousand fakes cost 75,000 versus a 40,000 emission pool, while an honest agent pays once and retains the bond.
